_comment: 형질변경-의심(=changed) negative 후보 풀. A1~A4 파이프라인 입력. 산지관리법상 산지전용 유형별로 1~2개 표현 변주(greedy가 더 나은 문구를 고르도록), + 저대비 앵커(초지)·자연지형 트랩(암석)을 딜레마 검정용으로 포함, + interior용 재질 문구. 부정문('not forest' 등)·단일 모호어·중복은 제거. cat=산지전용 유형, why=근거.

candidates.text: rows of dark blue solar panels covering a cleared slope
candidates.why: 산지전용 최다 유형. 사면 개간 맥락 명시

candidates.text: rows of solar photovoltaic panels
candidates.why: 동일 유형 일반 표현(문구 변주 비교)

candidates.text: a house or building with a fenced yard on leveled hillside ground
houses in a residential area
a large warehouse or factory shed with a bright metal roof
a wide paved road or machine-graded track cutting straight across the slope
a paved road
candidates.why: 동일 유형 일반 표현(임도 흡인 여부 비교용)

candidates.text: smooth machine-graded bare earth with tire tracks and a sharp cleared edge
candidates.why: 조성 나지 ↔ 겨울림 대비: 매끈+중장비+날카로운 경계

candidates.text: bare earth cleared of trees
a logged patch of bare soil dotted with small cut tree stumps
bare soil with a grid of small cut tree stumps
rows of white plastic greenhouse tunnels
plastic greenhouses
a plowed field or an orchard with fruit trees in rows on former forest land
rows of low rounded bare or grassy burial mounds
a quarry or open pit of excavated bare earth, gravel and rock
an open dirt yard with parked vehicles, shipping containers or stacked materials
a graded construction site with concrete foundations or retaining walls
an open field of grass or low weeds on ground where the forest was removed
candidates.why: 저대비 재식생 앵커. '제거된 자리'에 묶어 자연초지와 분리 (recall 앵커)

candidates.text: a grassy field
candidates.why: 무맥락 초지. FP·FN 양쪽 유발했던 문구 — 넣을지/뺄지 greedy가 판정

candidates.text: bare rocky ground
candidates.why: 자연 암석지. negative에 넣으면 임상 흡인 위험 — 딜레마 검정

candidates.text: exposed rock, gravel and landslide scars on a bare slope
smooth flat machine-graded bare soil
a smooth metal, tiled or solar panel surface
smooth asphalt or concrete pavement
